players.product: data-center chillers, BASX custom air handlers & liquid-cooling packages (Redmond / Memphis)

quarterly_data.signal: AAON's Q2 2026 earnings release gives backlog by brand (in thousands): BASX-branded backlog was $1,430,379 at June 30, 2026 versus $501,106 at June 30, 2025, up 185.4% year over year, which the release attributes to continued customer investment activity in data center infrastructure. Total backlog was $1,970,844, up 98.0% year over year and down 7.4% from the first quarter, primarily reflecting accelerated backlog conversion into record revenue and the timing variability of large BASX project awards.
quarterly_data.figure: BASX-branded backlog $1,430,379 thousand at June 30, 2026 (+185.4% YoY); total backlog $1,970,844 thousand (+98.0% YoY, -7.4% vs Q1 2026)

quarterly_data.signal: BASX-branded sales grew 216.2% to a record $345 million in Q2 2026, reflecting momentum in data center demand, higher production output and greater utilization of recently added manufacturing capacity.
